column1: # The runner scenario corpus: TestEveryDisagreementAndFailureIsRed runs
# every row against the one-case corpus/manifest.tsv (with its input) below this file (the case
# expects `refuse damaged`). No list carries a finding (docs/rulings.json
# no-skips): a disagreement is red by its case's name like any failure.
# child_answer: what the case binary does (the modes of TestMain).
# budget: spent  the case's budget has already run out when it starts
#         never  the case's budget never runs out
# success: whether the whole run must report success.
# the completed matching answer is success; every other answer is red, and a
# case over its budget is a hang whatever else is true
